lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: First, you went to the surface to carry out an operation without any prior report.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Second, you brought five Nikke along with you, far more than was necessary.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Third, despite this, your intentions were indeed an attempt to bring peace to mankind.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: On the basis of these facts, a search has shown that there are two cases perfectly matching this incident.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: The judgment for both cases was consistent.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Therefore, I hereby pronounce the same sentence, which is as follows:

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName} will be banned from all operations for two days.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Next, I shall pronounce the sentence of the Nikkes who were involved.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: First, you violated the key provision of protecting your Commander above all else.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Second, despite you realizing the operation violated the command system, you proceeded to carry it out.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Third, your misguided actions resulted in damage to valuable property belonging to the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: On the basis of these facts, a search has shown that there are two cases perfectly matching this incident.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: The judgment for both cases was consistent.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: To prevent such cases from reoccurring in the future, I hereby pronounce the following sentence:

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Given that Rapi and Mihara, the captains of Counters and Wardress, were the primary instigators behind this incident,

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: they shall have their memories erased.
